symbols.current_behavior: Requires previous.schema == jope.native_loop.v1 (refusing jope.native_loop.v2 weight-warm-start runs), completion.schema == jope.native_loop_completion.v1, target_optimizer_step == initial_optimizer_step + 6000, and identical scientific_policy/label_admission_policy/qualification/cuts/budgets.
symbols.capability_gap: Refuses jope.native_loop.v2 weight-warm-start successors and non-6000-step windows (e.g. 0->3000->6000); addressed by I11-I14 and D07/D28/C02 via explicit additive versioned ancestry without weakening legacy 60000/6000 checks.

symbols.current_behavior: Refuses REJECTED_STEP (69000, crates/jope-policy/src/lib.rs:173) and REJECTED_STATE_SHA256 / REJECTED_MODEL_SHA256, requires self.step > ACCEPTED_STEP (60000, crates/jope-policy/src/lib.rs:153), self.model_sha256 != ACCEPTED_MODEL_SHA256, exact state/parameter/config/policy_safetensors SHA-256 matches, and self.vocabulary_sha256 == CHECKPOINT_VOCABULARY_SHA256.
symbols.capability_gap: Numeric step check self.step > 60000 rejects legitimate low-step warm-start descendants (e.g. 3000-step optimizer-reset epochs) while numeric step alone would not prove ancestry without state/parent chain; addressed by I11 and I14 while keeping accepted serving checks strict.

symbols.current_behavior: Shared dispatch hold across 23 native GPU routes (17 direct require_original_gpu_grant call sites + 6 call sites via require_qualified_gpu_experiment); unconditionally returns Err("{route}: original native GPU grant verifier unavailable; numerical dispatch is held").
symbols.capability_gap: Intentional fail-closed hold; requires genuine issuer/verifier contract and explicit human/resource admission (I12, I65) before any live native GPU dispatch.

symbols.current_behavior: Offline diagnostic verifier (jope.selfplay-round-qualification/v1) that unconditionally sets qualified_claim: false, promotion: false, and l6_claim: false, checking either unpinned/no-grant prereg contracts or caller-asserted receipts with create-only O_EXCL output.
symbols.capability_gap: Offline verifier does not re-hash raw search/observation payloads or authenticate external execution grants; prospective estimand/roster/exposure/authority authentication is scheduled in I41-I43.

model_lineages.architecture: 512x6 PolicyLM (native tch / Candle; PolicyConfig::regression(401) at crates/jope-policy/src/config.rs:39-55 and neural::Config::regression at crates/jope-engine/src/neural.rs:45-60)
CLOVER / RLFW byte-piece prefix-trie policy (282-token vocabulary; dynamic jope.flywheel-full-catalog-trie/v1 trie)
model_lineages.trie_nodes_note: Trie<'a> in crates/jope-learning/src/support/trie.rs:6 is constructed dynamically from a loaded catalog artifact so trie_nodes has no compiled node-count constant; 2051 is a compiled source fact for the CLOVER PolicyLM context width (context_width == 2051 / PolicyLM/Kumo-2051 at crates/jope-learning/src/clover/expansion.rs:154-155 and ctx_dim2051, vocab282, max_seq640, d_model128 at crates/jope-learning/src/support/README.md:59), not a trie node count.

model_lineages.architecture: Weight-warm-start native loop protocol (jope.native_loop.v2, fresh FP32 AdamW, 3000-step block windows)
model_lineages.warm_start_override_note: crates/jope-engine/src/native_loop/warm_start.rs:24-83 binds parent checkpoint weights and optimizer reset windows (0->3000->6000) without overriding model width/layers; 256x2 appears only in planning docs (WORKPLAN.md / decisions.json D07) for prospective warm-start sizing, while neural::Config::regression in crates/jope-engine/src/neural.rs:45-60 defaults to width=512, layers=6.

source_findings.statement: Receiving main 22939ca1c67bdcc4beb54c5a4fbdb9e24073db2d includes all 134 existing source/test paths from FILE_MAP.json plus all 40 v4 planning packet files under docs/plans/algorithmic-selfplay-20261017/.

native_loop::verify_successor enforces jope.native_loop.v1 and +6000 optimizer step windows, and witness::epochs::validate_effective_shape enforces initial_optimizer_step >= 60000 && (initial_optimizer_step - 60000) % 6000 == 0.

CheckpointBinding::require_challenger_identity (called by CheckpointBinding::parse) requires step > ACCEPTED_STEP (60000), step != REJECTED_STEP (69000), and exact state/parameter/config/safetensors/vocabulary SHA-256 matches.

require_original_gpu_grant (and its wrapper require_qualified_gpu_experiment) is an unconditional fail-closed hold across 23 routes (17 direct + 6 via require_qualified_gpu_experiment) in crates/jope-engine/src/.
RoundQualReport in crates/jope-learning/src/clover/round_qual.rs is an offline diagnostic verifier that unconditionally sets qualified_claim, promotion, and l6_claim to false.

Lineage B step-60000 (ACCEPTED_STATE_SHA256 = 8ac80c269cc47c253b6f53fa3bc1eb75bb2fcda0bdace3ff8554be0175c400d6) is the accepted serving policy; step-69000 (REJECTED_STEP in crates/jope-policy/src/lib.rs:173) and step-60100 (historical RTX 3090 continuation in ADR-0005) are not serving promotions.
Claim that all prior learning runs had zero optimizer updates or that planning PR #356 implements the 66 I-tasks.
